name: portable-pty
safety: Owned directory Arc retained across fork; async-signal-safe fchdir before close_random_fds; parent cwd unchanged; serialization of a live handle rejected.
windows_changes: ConPTY roots start suspended, join a retained kill-on-close job, then resume. Batch command lines use the explicitly supplied interpreter and a bounded encoder; runtime retains script and interpreter file pins. ChildKiller exposes a non-inheritable duplicate of the retained Job Object with JOB_OBJECT_QUERY rights only; no PID-based job lookup is used. The Windows adapter requires the pinned Microsoft ConPTY runtime beside the executable to avoid the Server 2022 system API process-handle leak; Cargo stages the runtime for native builds and tests.

batch_encoder_source.modifications: No raw arguments; bounded length; escaping also applies to script paths. Rust license text is also included in LICENSE.md for release bundles.
